newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at sixth straight record close.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at sixth straight record close.

text.p: The FTSE 100 finished off the day's best levels on Friday but at a sixth consecutive closing peak as bid speculation and stock shortages fuelled the financials to record levels.

The leading stock index ended more than one percent or 50.5 points higher at 4,630.9, to chalk up a rise of four percent this week. But gains were not broad-based and the Mid-250 failed to match the leaders, ending 15.8 points higher at 4,526.2.
"People are still surprised by the strength of this market," said one senior dealer "The banks featured once again, outperforming the rest of the market in a massive way."
